name: Jukuzuma Toushi Claudia Revenge Kutsujoku no Jukunyuuzuma Hakudaku Rinkan
original_name: 熟妻闘士クラウディアリベンジ　屈辱の熟乳妻白濁輪姦
source:
Ex-fencer Claudia became a fighter in an illegal arena ruled by Albino to search her missing husband. Trapped and in captive, she gets humiliated in rope-like bikini armor.
Story goes while involving other female fencers whose names are Yuria, Livia and Albia.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE051927.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
前击剑选手克劳迪娅为了寻找失踪的丈夫，成为阿尔比诺掌控的非法斗技场中的战士。身陷囹圄后，她穿着如绳缚般暴露的比基尼铠甲受尽凌辱。故事还会牵涉尤莉娅、莉维娅与阿尔比娅等其他女剑士。

[译自 [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE051927.html]DLsite English[/url]]
